Name: Harbour wall
Description: Waves against a harbour wall (ShoreSpec.HarbourWall, ShoreSynth): thrown back off the stone, slapping it and falling back. Its box is the stretch of edge it stands for: X its length along the edge, Z the fetch, how far the water reaches straight out from it; turn the entity so its +Z faces the water. Silent in a calm. Not a recording and not a loop.
